entries.title: Introduction
learningOutcomes: Explain what kind of applications JSVision builds and where they run.
Run the live shell and identify the next course for a chosen goal.

entries.title: Install & packages
learningOutcomes: Choose the smallest package set for a terminal, browser, forms, files, grid, or editor application.
Configure a Node 22+ ESM TypeScript project that imports public JSVision entry points.
entries.liveExampleException: Package installation and module resolution are build-time behaviors that an in-page terminal cannot demonstrate honestly.

entries.title: Codex plugin
learningOutcomes: Install and invoke the supported JSVision Codex plugin workflow.
Distinguish generated plugin guidance from canonical repository sources.
entries.liveExampleException: Codex installation and host integration happen outside the browser documentation runtime.

entries.title: Layout
learningOutcomes: Compose responsive terminal-cell interfaces with rows, columns, sizing, spacing, and alignment.
Choose deliberately between flow layout, overlays, and exact placement.
Diagnose collapsed, clipped, and translation-sensitive layouts.

entries.title: Reactive state
learningOutcomes: Model source and derived state with signals and computed values.
Bind state to views and coordinate effects, batching, and dynamic dependencies.
Own, clean up, and dispose reactive work safely.

entries.title: Views & focus
learningOutcomes: Explain retained view trees, mounting, invalidation, and ownership.
Design predictable tab order, focus entry, restoration, and modal focus behavior.

entries.title: Events, commands & keymaps
learningOutcomes: Trace keyboard, mouse, paste, and command events through the view tree.
Define discoverable commands and resolve keymap precedence without collisions.

entries.title: Keyboard & clipboard
learningOutcomes: Use the default editing and selection chords consistently.
Choose native, browser, or custom clipboard adapters and explain their authorization boundaries.

entries.title: Text, Unicode & terminal cells
learningOutcomes: Reason about terminal cells, graphemes, wide glyphs, combining marks, wrapping, and clipping.
Build text interfaces that remain legible across Unicode and ASCII-safe capability profiles.

entries.title: Scrolling, lists & large content
learningOutcomes: Choose between Scroller, ListView, ListBox, Tree, SurfaceView, and windowed data sources.
Coordinate viewport offsets, focus, selection, scroll bars, and bounded rendering.

entries.title: The application shell
learningOutcomes: Construct and run a complete application with menu, status, content, and quit behavior.
Choose a Desktop or Router body and manage window commands and lifecycle.

entries.title: Dialogs & modality
learningOutcomes: Await modal dialogs and interpret the command or value that resolves them.
Build validation, nested confirmation, cancellation, and focus-safe dialog workflows.

entries.title: Async work, cancellation & progress
learningOutcomes: Run asynchronous work without blocking input or rendering.
Model cancellation, progress, errors, cleanup, and stale-result protection.

entries.title: Forms
learningOutcomes: Build typed form state, field bindings, validation, submission, and reset workflows.
Coordinate async validation and loading while preserving honest user feedback.

entries.title: Files & the FileSystem seam
learningOutcomes: Use file and directory workflows through the host-neutral FileSystem seam.
Run the same file UI against Node, browser-virtual, and application-defined file systems.

entries.title: Internationalization
learningOutcomes: Define, load, validate, and switch locale catalogs through public entry points.
Design translated layouts, formatted values, diagnostics, and multilingual QA.

entries.title: Screens & routing
learningOutcomes: Model full-screen navigation with typed routes, parameters, history, and shared chrome.
Preserve or release screen state and focus deliberately across navigation.

entries.title: Theming & colour depth
learningOutcomes: Author semantic themes and select exact roles for component states.
Preserve contrast and meaning through truecolor, 256-color, 16-color, and monochrome degradation.

entries.title: Running in the browser
learningOutcomes: Mount an unchanged application through the browser runtime and xterm.js host.
Handle browser capabilities, clipboard authorization, keyboard reclaim, resize, and virtual files.

entries.title: Writing your own widget
learningOutcomes: Implement measurement, drawing, invalidation, focus, and input for a custom View.
Compose and test reusable widgets without bypassing ownership or clipping boundaries.

entries.title: Testing headlessly
learningOutcomes: Mount views and applications without a real terminal and inspect rendered cells.
Drive input, modal flows, resize, cleanup, and failure paths deterministically.
entries.liveExampleException: The authentic runnable artifact is a test module and test-runner output, not an interactive terminal demonstration.

entries.title: Application architecture & best practices
learningOutcomes: Separate domain state, services, commands, screens, and view composition into durable boundaries.
Choose ownership and dependency directions that keep a growing application testable and disposable.

entries.title: Data Grid course
learningOutcomes: Build typed read-only and editable grids from quick start through windowed data.
Apply sorting, filtering, editing, validation, aggregation, personalization, accessibility, and performance guidance.

entries.title: Code Editor course
learningOutcomes: Build terminal-native editing experiences with documents, controllers, navigation, languages, and folding.
Integrate LSP features, themes, large-document behavior, authorization, safety, and recovery.

entries.title: Debugging
learningOutcomes: Diagnose layout, focus, command, rendering, capability, and host-lifecycle failures.
Collect safe logs, frame evidence, and minimal reproductions without corrupting the terminal.

entries.title: Crash safety & terminal restore
learningOutcomes: Explain restoration guarantees across normal exit, exceptions, and process signals.
Distinguish essential terminal requirements from graceful capability degradations.
entries.liveExampleException: A browser terminal cannot prove native raw-mode, alternate-screen, cursor, or process-signal restoration.

entries.title: Displaying untrusted text safely
learningOutcomes: Identify terminal-injection and sensitive-log threats at every raw text boundary.
Use built-in sanitization, explicit sanitization, and redaction without making false security claims.

entries.title: Accessibility & resilient interaction
learningOutcomes: Design keyboard-complete, discoverable interactions with visible focus and non-color state cues.
Preserve meaning under NO_COLOR, monochrome, ASCII fallback, reduced geometry, and browser documentation constraints.

entries.title: Terminal capabilities & portability
learningOutcomes: Explain capability detection, profiles, queries, overrides, and degradations.
Adapt applications honestly across SSH, tmux, Windows, browser, color, mouse, and glyph differences.

entries.title: In production
learningOutcomes: Package, deploy, observe, and support a Node or Bun ESM terminal application.
Set evidence-based compatibility, security, performance, and operational expectations.
entries.liveExampleException: Deployment, process supervision, container security, and production terminal evidence cannot be reproduced by an embedded browser terminal.

entries.title: Build a complete application
learningOutcomes: Build a cohesive application from project setup through state, navigation, async work, persistence, and tests.
Apply accessibility, security, failure recovery, packaging, and production verification as one release workflow.
